def: properly, to carve or engrave, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe indelibly

occurrences.text: For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord God.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
